series.summary: L sets an ironclad trap against Light before Misa identifies L's true name with Shinigami eyes, only for L to steal Misa's phone and arrest her as the Second Kira.

title: L Traps the Second Kira Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: L just set the ultimate death trap against Light Yagami. Sitting inside the police task force headquarters, the eccentric detective looks straight at Chief Yagami and drops a chilling declaration: if he happens to die within the next few days, his son is Kira. Chief Yagami recoils in shock, demanding an explanation. The entire task force is stunned. Yet L remains completely calm, warning that if Kira and the Second Kira unite, this desperate wager is his only way to expose the truth.

On the university campus, Light and L stand together when Misa Amane suddenly runs up to greet them. In that single moment, the entire balance of power shifts. Light realizes that Misa possesses the Shinigami eyes and can see L's real name floating right above his head. L introduces himself under the fake alias of a famous pop idol, but Misa immediately spots the contradiction between his spoken name and his true identity. Light looks at his rival with intense inner triumph. He believes L made a fatal mistake by showing up in person, and that total victory is now within his grasp.

After Misa's manager pulls her away through the cheering crowd, Light slips into an empty corridor to make the kill. He dials Misa's cell phone to learn L's real name and write it down. He waits eagerly for her answer, but the voice that speaks is not Misa. It is L. The detective casually announces that someone dropped this phone during the commotion outside. Light freezes in disbelief. L intentionally pickpocketed Misa's phone while brushing past her in the crowd. Light forces himself to sound calm, but inside, his guaranteed triumph has instantly vanished into thin air.

Light prepares to dial Misa's secret backup phone, but his screen suddenly rings again with an incoming call from L. The detective delivers devastating news. Forensic investigators have just raided Misa's apartment, discovering hairs and packaging fibers that match the tape used on the Second Kira's threatening broadcast tapes. Misa has officially been taken into custody. Light is paralyzed with dread. He realizes L deliberately stayed glued to him on campus as a distraction while the police closed in. With Misa trapped in interrogation, Light faces an impossible crisis: how can he save her before she breaks?
